page_title: WER 1-0 PAU | Werder Bremen v St. Pauli 04/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Soren Storks shows a yellow card to Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' CLOSE! Victor Boniface (Werder Bremen) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the right post!
90+3' Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A yellow card for a tackle by Marco Grull (Werder Bremen). Soren Storks doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
88' A neat pass is well received by Marco Grull (Werder Bremen), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
86' St. Pauli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

85' This shall not pass! Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. St. Pauli are awarded a corner kick.
84' Great touch by Patrice Covic (Werder Bremen) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
83' Soren Storks blows for a foul after Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
81' Horst Steffen decides to make a substitution. Samuel Mbangula will be replaced by Victor Boniface (Werder Bremen).
81' Here comes a substitution. Patrice Covic (Werder Bremen) is brought on as a substitute for Cameron Puertas.
79' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post.
76' Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes a whisker over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
76' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
75' Karim Coulibaly (Werder Bremen) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
74' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
74' The attendance for today's match is 42100.
72' Soren Storks shows a yellow card to Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) for a tough tackle.
71' The manager makes a subsitution with Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli) coming on for James Sands.
71' Alexander Blessin prepares a substitution. Lars Ritzka is replaced by Abdoulie Ceesay (St. Pauli).
71' The referee allows time for a substitution. Arkadiusz Pyrka will be replaced by Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli).
69' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) takes the free kick from distance but the defensive wall makes the block.
68' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) disagrees with the decision of the referee and is given a yellow card.
65' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
64' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
60' We are about to witness a subsitution. Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) for Justin Njinmah.
59' The resulting set piece from Werder Bremen is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
57' Soren Storks has a clear sight and sees a foul from Joel Fujita (St. Pauli).
56' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Soren Storks no option but to blow his whistle.
53' Flag up against Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
52' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) heads on.
49' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
49' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Werder Bremen.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Horst Steffen is forced to make a change. Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Isaac Schmidt.
42' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) picks up an injury.
41' Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) was too forceful with his tackle and Soren Storks interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
41' Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders.
39' Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post.
38' The linesman signals that Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
37' St. Pauli are seeing far more of the ball now.
36' Soren Storks couldn't ignore the rough tackle by James Sands (St. Pauli) and blew his whistle.
34' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
32' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
30' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

27' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Nikola Vasilj was alert and the score remained the same.
23' Karim Coulibaly (Werder Bremen) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar.
23' Dangerous play by Joel Fujita (St. Pauli). Soren Storks blows his whistle for a foul.
21' James Sands (St. Pauli) probably handled the ball.
17' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
14' 50:50 – the ratio of ball possession.
11' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
10' James Sands (St. Pauli) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Soren Storks blows for a foul. Werder Bremen earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
10' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) serves up a nice cross, but Nikola Vasilj punches the ball away.
9' A quickly taken corner by Werder Bremen.

9' Great save! Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the roof of the net was brilliantly saved by Nikola Vasilj. Werder Bremen force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
7' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
5' Some great controlled play and passing from St. Pauli. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

2' 1 - 0 Goal! Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Nikola Vasilj is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:0.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Werder Bremen will have the kick-off.
